verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec, and the probe found that every candidate OpenAPI and Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt file, the markdown docs, the MCP server and the CLI are related agent-friendly features, not an API spec, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
